mechanism: Turmeric (curcumin) may inhibit COMT and MAO enzymes, potentially increasing levodopa levels and enhancing dopaminergic effects, while also possessing mild anticoagulant properties.
action: Monitor for increased levodopa side effects (dyskinesia, nausea, orthostatic hypotension); consider spacing administration and counsel on consistent turmeric use to avoid fluctuating levodopa levels.
